newsitem.title: FRANCE: Elf, Total up on crude, dollar.
newsitem.headline: Elf, Total up on crude, dollar.

text.p: Increases in crude prices and in the U.S. dollar helped boost shares in French oil majors Elf Aquitaine and Total, which benefit from both trends, brokers said on Monday.
Shares in Total were up 1.91 percent at 426 francs at 1500 GMT and Elf shares were 1.5 percent higher at 495.20. The bourse's CAC-40 index was up 1.5 percent.

Brokers said Elf was helped by remarks by the president of Azerbaijan, Haydar Aliyev, who said during a visit to France that his country would sign an oil exploration deal with Elf. They said Total was helped by the fact that PaineWebber had initiated coverage.
